The [[Sakiyan/Legends|Sakiyan]] [[Restaurant/Legends|restauranteur]] [[Tuden Sal]] was [[Marriage/Legends|married]] to a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Sakiyan/Legends|Sakiyan]], his '''mate''', at some point during the latter [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. When [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] initiated a hostile takeover bid for Tuden's business interests through a proxy, the process cost Tuden not only his business, but also his mate.
